_about: Public-domain Heman Humphrey (1779-1861), Congregational minister and second President of Amherst College, for the Word Hoard: Essays upon the Origin, Perpetuity, Change and Proper Observance of the Sabbath (1829), Miscellaneous Discourses and Reviews (1834), Domestic Education (1840), Thirty-Four Letters to a Son in the Ministry (1842), the Memoir of Nathan W. Fiske (1850), The Life and Labors of T. H. Gallaudet (1857) and Revival Sketches and Manual (1859). from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 60 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
